character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A small wiry goblin raider with bright olive-green skin, long pointed ears, a big toothy grin, brass goggles pushed up on its forehead, a dark topknot. Patched brown leather vest, a torn strip of blue academy cloth with a gold star tied at its waist, bare clawed feet. A jagged steel knife held low in its right hand, crouched and ready to run. Bold readable pixel art, chunky shapes, dark outline.
